strategy: Expand crawlable search coverage and internal authority without changing the current title, meta description, H1, canonical or dynamic statewide finder.

evidence.queryAttributionCaution: Query rows are sitewide directional evidence and are not treated as a page-query join.

measurement.leadingBaseline: 77 impressions / 0 clicks / position 13.17 over the latest 7 complete days
measurement.successRule: Look for materially higher impressions and a broader non-duplicate query footprint while average position holds or improves. Do not attribute normal seasonal change to the treatment without a comparable baseline.
measurement.comparisonRule: Compare average daily impressions, not raw 7-day versus 28-day totals; treat seasonal demand as context and preserve the position guardrail.
